newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold ends down on fresh imports, silver dull.
newsitem.headline: India gold ends down on fresh imports, silver dull.

text.p: Gold prices closed lower on Monday on the back of fresh arrivals against special import licence and sluggish seasonal enquiries, dealers said.
Gold was down by 45 rupees per 10 grammes during last week.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees lower at 58,800 rupees per piece on Monday, dealers said.
Biscuit prices were down by 550 rupees during last week.
Silver opened lower and extended losses towards the close on fresh arrivals of 1,500 kg of imported silver, traders said.
Silver was up 15 rupees per kg during last week.
